cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says the system checks fingerprints, face or iris to stop one person enrolling twice; the World Bank's 2025 note of an ABIS for authentication and fraud prevention does not say it deduplicates enrolment.
cells.note: Stage 3: the system issues national IDs and captures fingerprints and faces. The 2025 World Bank account of an under-capacity ABIS used for authentication and fraud prevention does not show enrolments checked for duplicates, so stage 4 is not met.
